The '''Jedi Temple''', also known as the '''Ilum Temple''', was an ancient structure on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] constructed by the early [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as they spread out from [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and established training grounds across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was selected for its isolation and placed over a massive subterranean network of [[Crystal Cave/Legends|caves]] in which the Order's rare [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] grew. While the training grounds were eventually abandoned, Ilum's temple served as a mecca for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] seeking to construct their very own lightsaber.

==History==
===Construction===
[[File:LightsaberConstruction-CW14.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Members of the Jedi Order conduct a ritual during the construction of a lightsaber.]]
During the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] formative years circa [[22,800 BBY]], [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] scouts for the Order discovered the frozen world of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and unearthed its [[Crystal Cave/Legends|hidden treasure trove]] of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]], prized for their usage as a focus lens in the Order's symbolic weapon, the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. As the [[Adegan crystal/Legends|crystals]] of [[Adega]] were the primary source of crystals previous to the discovery, the kathracite, mephite, and pontite crystals found on Ilum bolstered the Order' stockpiles to these rare formations.<ref name="JvS" /> The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] decided to establish a temple and training center on the inhospitable world, embracing the cold and the isolation the world afforded the Order. In order to keep their solitude undisturbed, the Order kept the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and the world's coordinates a secret,<ref name="TOR" /> per [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] law giving the Order exclusive access to all planetary discoveries.<ref name="SWDP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

===Old Sith Wars===
Indeed, the route to Ilum was not only treacherous but required [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] to navigate; this extremely difficult trek was the first test for students seeking to train on the world. As the training grounds on Ilum saw its heyday in the years preceding the rise of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the ravages of war saw the facility downsize considerably. As the number of Jedi stationed on the world dwindled, the Temple was maintained by an honor guard while it received visitors seeking to construct their lightsabers. Treks on Ilum were known to be hazardous throughout history. One of the earliest visitors, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Seta-Le]], fell through a weak patch of ice into a dark cavern. Having broken her lightsaber during her fall, Seta-Le was able to use her knowledge of the lightsaber's inner workings and apply it to a large crystal formation in the cave. Once activated, the beam created was able to melt through the ice and enable her escape.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:TOR-IlumTemple.png|thumb|right|250px|The Jedi Temple during the [[Galactic War]].]]
The Temple was threatened once more during the [[Great Galactic War]], a conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the Republic. As the Empire swiftly attacked the world, the few Jedi stationed there were overwhelmed and quickly [[Battle of Ilum (Great Galactic War)|slain]]. As the Empire began to garrison troops on the world the Temple was made inaccessible and, due to thinly-stretched resources, the Order was unable to reclaim it for over a decade.<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> during the [[Galactic War]], Republic and Imperial forces clashed on the planet. During the [[Battle of Ilum]], Republic and Jedi forces battled Imperial troops in the Temple and defeated [[Darth Arho]].<ref name="TJT">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Jedi Temple|Ilum}}</ref>

Following the destruction of the Sith Empire the Order restored their Temple on Ilum and once more maintained a small group of Jedi on the planet to protect their coveted crystals.<ref name="PTT">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>

===Golden Age of the Old Republic===
During the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]], the Temple and the caves below were a constant journey point for members of the Order. As the caves only produced [[Color/Legends|blue]] and green crystals, the Order's members carried weapons that reflected this as Ilum held the largest stockpile of crystals.<ref name="DB-Ilum">{{DB|location|ilum|Ilum}}</ref> During the final decades of the Republic, the young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] ventured into the Temple's caves and sought to create his first lightsaber. Like many before him the Force-permeated grottoes induced [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]] or hallucinations, sending him into [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] with a manifestation of the [[Darth Maul/Legends|mysterious]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] his master had killed on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Upon defeating the manifestation, Skywalker realized his lightsaber was complete and left the Temple with his new weapon.<ref name="PTT" />

Several years later during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a deadly conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Jedi Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] led her Padawan [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] into the Temple to instruct her as she crafted her lightsaber. Upon completion of the ancient ritual the pair were attacked by Confederate [[Spelunker probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] sent to destroy the caves by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the leader of the Separatist movement.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 14">{{CW|14}}</ref> During the [[Ambush on Ilum|skirmish]], the caves were heavily damaged by bombs placed by the droids and the Master-Padawan team were trapped under rubble. Detecting the disturbance, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], leader of the Order, descended upon Ilum and entered the Temple in time to rescue Unduli and her student.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 16">{{CW|16}}</ref>

[[File:Jedifend.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jedi defending the Temple from Confederacy intruders during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]

Following the attack, the Jedi High Council determined that the coordinates to the secret Jedi world were compromised by Dooku, a former member of the Order who had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and become a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Fearing that the Confederacy would use to caves' treasures against the Order or prohibit Jedi from making new lightsabers, the Council ordered that all crystals be harvested and taken to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for safe keeping. As for the Temple, reconstruction efforts would take a year before it was safe for students to reenter, while all treks were placed on hold.<ref name="JvS" />

====The Gathering====
[[File:IlumJediTempleInterior-TG.png|thumb|right|250px|A group of Initiates enter the temple for [[Gathering (20 BBY)/Legends|The Gathering]]]]
{{Main|Gathering/Legends}}

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] including [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]], [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]], [[Byph/Legends|Byph]], [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], and [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]] came to collect their [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|Lightsaber crystals]] for the construction of their [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsabers]].<ref name="TCW:TG">{{TCW|The Gathering (episode)}}</ref>

===Rise of the Empire===
[[File:Ilum_Jedi_Temple_entrance_FDNP.png|thumb|left|250px|A Twi'lek Force-user approaches the entrance to the crystal caves.]]
When the war concluded with the overthrow of the Galactic Republic and the dissolution of the Jedi Order, the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took control of the coordinates to Ilum. Several Jedi found their way back to Ilum, assuming it would be safe and hiding in the Temple's caves. Among the survivors were Masters [[Fy-Tor-Ana]] and [[Garen Muln]]; Master Ana soon departed for Coruscant while Muln wasted away inside the caverns. Within months of the start of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], former Jedi Padawan [[Ferus Olin]] went searching the caves and discovered Muln ill near-death. Rescuing the Jedi Master, Olin escaped offworld before the Imperials secretly stationed on the world were able to reach the fugitive Jedi.<ref name="DW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning]]''</ref>

==Layout==
[[File:Ilum_Jedi_Temple_layout_FDNP.png|thumb|right|250px|A diagram of the temple layout]]
Constructed in the icy face of one of Ilum's frozen mountain cliffs, the Jedi Temple was snow-covered and bare. The vast entrance was hidden behind large sheets of ice which adhered to the Temple facade after long periods of disuse. Large [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] windows let in the pale light from the snow-swept world, illuminating the cave-like interior of the Temple. Inside the main tower of the Temple, the Jedi Order carved long elegant pillars into the circular chambers high walls, and adorned the room with tall statues of Jedi. Along the upper walls of the chamber, circular windows could be opened to allow in natural light using the Force. When the light shined through, it refracted through a series of massive crystals suspended in the chamber and when focused with the Force, would melt the ice which formed over the entrance to the Crystal Caves.<ref name="TCW:TG" /> This crystal array was originally used by the trapped [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Seta-Le]] several millennia before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> When melted, the ice wall ran down like a waterfall to reveal the massive gates leading into the darkness. Beyond, tall and slender black rock formations stood like pillars in the main hall; embedded in each were hundreds of small [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] that appeared to shimmer in the dim light. Spiraling ramps stretched into the darkness of the place, leading to seldom used rooms and construction galleries.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 14">{{CW|14}}</ref>

Deep within the heart of the Temple were other paths into the caves, caverns made of natural shiny black stone; a rock that swallowed light instead of reflecting it. As time progressed and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] grew, the many Jedi that visited the cave recorded their histories on its walls, expansive cave etchings that seemed to come to life during the Force-induced hallucinations many Jedi were known to succumb to while constructing their weapons.<ref name="Jedi Quest 1">[[Jedi Quest 1|''Jedi Quest'' 1]]</ref> The caves of the Temple held many secrets such as a hidden entrance that led into the subterranean grottoes. During the later centuries [[Gorgodon/Legends|gorgodons]] began to nest in this area, making the entrance more of a hazard then a shortcut.<ref name="DW" />
